summary: First Merchants Corporation filed an 8-K on August 14, 2026, announcing a routine quarterly cash dividend of $0.37 per common share, payable September 18, 2026, to shareholders of record September 4, 2026. The press release furnished as Exhibit 99.1 contains no special-situations elements such as takeover activity, restructuring, or strategic review. This is an ordinary dividend declaration, not a special situation. No advisors, premiums, or structural details are mentioned. Monitor for future filings that could signal a special event, but this is routine.
